title: crapkit.toml
description: crapkit configuration: scopes, coverage lanes, exclusions, targets

target.description: repo-wide CRAP ceiling; above it a function cannot be saved by coverage (default 6)

churn_window_months.description: git log window for churn weighting (default 12)

alert_command.description: command that receives digest/override alerts on stdin

notes.description: repo-wide operational traps, quoted verbatim to whoever is about to edit this repo

scoped_tests.description: scope name -> isolated test command template ({files} placeholder)

mutation_command.description: suite run once per mutant; nonzero exit = killed

mutation_timeout_seconds.description: per-mutant timeout; expiry counts as killed (default 300)

mutation_workers.description: mutants run in parallel, one detached git worktree each (default 1 = the live tree)

diff_uncovered_max.description: verify exits 9 when more changed lines than this never ran (absent = warn only)

debt_max_age_months.description: ratchet report --enforce flags marks older than this

repayment_min_per_30d.description: ratchet report --enforce flags fewer repayments than this while debt is open

max_parallel_lanes.description: lanes running at once during coverage/verify; 1 = strictly serial (default 1)

analysis_workers.description: lizard process pool size; 0 = one worker per core (default 0)

target.description: per-scope ceiling overriding the repo target

coverage_optional.description: code no test can reach: scored cc-only (crap = ccn), needs no lane

notes.description: operational traps specific to this scope, quoted verbatim to whoever edits its files

artifact.description: repo-relative coverage artifact the command writes

path_prefix.description: prefix joined onto coverage.py relative paths

full_suite.description: false permits positional narrowing in a pytest coverage command

results_artifact.description: junit XML feeding the no-NEW-failures check

timeout_seconds.description: crapkit kills the command past this (0 = no timeout)

retries.description: reruns after a timeout or missing artifact

retest_command.description: {tests} template rerunning just the newly-failed ids before exit 8

max_file_bytes.description: files larger than this many bytes leave the corpus, minified blobs included (absent = no limit)
